originals.citation: Sun, Y., Huang, Y., et al. (2015). Genome-wide association study identifies a new susceptibility locus for cleft lip with or without a cleft palate. Nature Communications.

quote: A recent genome-wide association study (GWAS) among Chinese populations has identified a new region at 16p13.3 as being associated with NSCL/P, which requires further replication. Here, we attempted to replicate and further clarify the genetic association between this region and NSCL/P
notes: The 16p13.3 locus was reported by Sun et al. 2015 (Chinese GWAS).
